## Demande de l'utilisateur
prometheus avec le maximum de mémoire possible sur ce cluster

## Ta tentative précédente a été REJETÉE
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: prometheus-config
  namespace: default
  labels:
    app: prometheus
  annotations: {}
data:
  prometheus.yml: "global:\n  scrape_interval: 15s\nscrape_configs:\n  - job_name:\
    \ 'prometheus'\n    static_configs:\n      - targets: ['localhost:9090']\n"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: prometheus-data
  namespace: default
  labels:
    app: prometheus
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 20Gi
  storageClassName: gp3
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: prometheus
  namespace: default
  labels:
    app: prometheus
spec:
  serviceName: prometheus
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: prometheus
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: prometheus
    spec:
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 65534
      containers:
      - name: prometheus
        image: prom/prometheus:v2.53.0
        ports:
        - containerPort: 9090
          name: http
        args:
        - --config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
        - --storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 2500m
            memory: 26Gi
          limits:
            cpu: 2500m
            memory: 26Gi
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /-/ready
            port: http
          initialDelaySeconds: 10
          periodSeconds: 10
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /-/healthy
            port: http
          initialDelaySeconds: 30
          periodSeconds: 15
        volumeMounts:
        - name: config-volume
          mountPath: /etc/prometheus
        - name: data-volume
          mountPath: /prometheus
      volumes:
      - name: config-volume
        configMap:
          name: prometheus-config
          items:
          - key: prometheus.yml
            path: prometheus.yml
  volumeClaimTemplates:
  - metadata:
      name: data-volume
      labels:
        app: prometheus
    spec:
      accessModes:
      - ReadWriteOnce
      resources:
        requests:
          storage: 20Gi
      storageClassName: gp3
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: prometheus
  namespace: default
  labels:
    app: prometheus
spec:
  selector:
    app: prometheus
  ports:
  - protocol: TCP
    port: 9090
    targetPort: 9090
  type: ClusterIP
```

- [capacité · ne tient sur aucun nœud] StatefulSet/prometheus : un pod demande 2500m CPU et 26624Mi, mais le nœud le plus libre n'offre que 5080m et 18227Mi. Les pods resteraient Pending.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: production
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:1.27.0
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 256Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: 80
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 10
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: 80
          initialDelaySeconds: 15
          periodSeconds: 20
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 101
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: production
spec:
  selector:
    app: web
  ports:
  - protocol: TCP
    port: 80
    targetPort: 80
---
apiVersion: extensions/v1beta1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: web-ingress
  namespace: production
spec:
  rules:
  - host: web.example.com
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: web
            port:
              number: 80
